text:
mira: follow-up on parceling experiment idea  proposing a "parcel heartbeat / leash" mechanism to reduce wasted prefetch and bound how long prefetched KV stays resident. heartbeat lets scheduler extend horizon only while parcel shows forward progress. thoughts?

lee: sounds promising. how do you detect "progress" for a streaming generation? token emission? accelerator accept?

mira: token emission or endpoint ACKs. simple rule: if parcel emits any token within heartbeat_interval, extend; otherwise mark horizon evictable after leash_timeout. default heartbeat 50ms, leash_timeout 200ms for interactive.

noah: we need to be careful: network jitter + batching could make short gaps look like stalls and cause premature eviction. maybe use a leaky-bucket smoothing to avoid flapping.

mira: yes, plan is to smooth by requiring two consecutive heartbeat misses before eviction for noisy networks. also track recent latency to tune thresholds per-tenant.

samir: operational questions: will heartbeat be emitted from runtime per-parcel and flow through tracing? we need that visibility to debug cross-parcel hops.

mira: runtime will emit an event per-parcel: PARCEL_HEARTBEAT {request_id, parcel_idx, ts, emitted_tokens}. these are sampled but correlated to request_id. logs + metrics.

lee: what about RPC/connection count? parceling may increase RPCs. can we multiplex parcels over the same GRPC stream to avoid extra connections?

mira: yes — we plan to multiplex parcels of the same request over persistent streams. parcels get ids and the stream encodes parcel lifecycle events. sketch of protocol:

```proto
message ParcelStart { string request_id = 1; int32 parcel_idx = 2; int32 tokens = 3; }
message ParcelHeartbeat { string request_id = 1; int32 parcel_idx = 2; int32 emitted = 3; }
message ParcelFinish { string request_id = 1; int32 parcel_idx = 2; }
```

noah: good. multiplexing eases connection pressure. we still need headroom accounting: each parcel consumes a "credit" from tenant headroom ledger. credits are released on ParcelFinish or eviction.

lee: headroom ledger design thought: credits are priced differently for prefetch vs executing; prefetch credits can be cheaper (evictable) but still count toward a soft cap. this lets scheduler overcommit slightly for prefetch.

mira: exactly. two-tier credits: soft_prefetch_credit and hard_exec_credit. prefetch credits are reclaimed first under pressure. ledger exposes metrics: soft_prefetch_in_use, hard_exec_in_use.

samir: billing and usage clarity: we must make it impossible to inflate billed usage by background prefetches. billing will always be tied to tokens emitted plus explicit prefetch bytes when they cross de-eviction threshold. add a billing FAQ entry.

noah: experiments: start with mux+heartbeat on staging for 2b-only. measure: per-request P50/P95/P99, prefetch_eviction_rate, connection_count, billing-delta. goal: <2% P99 regression, 10-20% headroom peak reduction, prefetch_waste <5%.

mira: rollout plan: feature-flagged path -> opt-in customers -> canary -> GA. add Dedicated compatibility: two modes: strict (no cross-host fallback) and 'elastic' (allow fallback). heartbeat semantics remain same.

lee: QA tests: simulate network jitter, long-tail stall (client pause), and thousand-concurrent-small-requests to validate eviction doesn't thrash. also test teardown during partial parcel execution (cancel received mid-parcel).

samir: add observability: parcel_active_count_gauge, parcel_eviction_counter (labels: reason), per-request_parcel_sequence map in traces. alert if eviction spikes or mux stream errors >0.1%.

mira: I'll update RFC draft to include: protocol sketch, headroom ledger model, telemetry table, experiment metrics, and compatibility appendix. will add sample log lines and error cases.

ops-bot: feature-flag "parcel-heartbeat-mux" enabled in staging at 2024-06-22T09:10Z

noah: one last note: consider adaptive parcel sizing: if a request keeps progressing quickly, grow subsequent parcels to reduce overhead. reverse if it stalls. state machine per-request tracks success rate and tunes parcel_size_hint.

mira: good idea. include adaptive sizing as a future extension in RFC (post-canary). thanks all, I'll open the PR and tag reviewers. :sparkles:
